# Stage 1: Single theme defiance / tax withholding (20 <= oe_theme_loyalty < 35).
oe_t2_crisis.1 = {
    type = country_event
    outcome = negative
    title = oe_t2_crisis.1.t
    image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_byz_siege_walls.dds"
    desc = oe_t2_crisis.1.d
    trigger = {
        oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes
        has_variable = oe_t2_crisis_theme
    }
    immediate = {
        remove_variable = oe_t2_enforcer_theme
        var:oe_t2_crisis_theme ?= { save_scope_as = oe_t2_ct }
        if = {
            limit = {
                exists = scope:oe_t2_ct
                any_subject = { oe_t2_loyal_enforcer_trigger = yes }
            }
            ordered_subject = {
                limit = { oe_t2_loyal_enforcer_trigger = yes }
                order_by = regular_army_size
                max = 1
                check_range_bounds = no
                save_scope_as = oe_t2_enforcer_pick
            }
            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:oe_t2_enforcer_pick }
                set_variable = { name = oe_t2_enforcer_theme value = scope:oe_t2_enforcer_pick }
            }
        }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_t2_crisis.1.a
        trigger = {
            gold >= 150
            manpower >= 1
            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= { var:oe_pillars_authority >= 5 }
        }
        custom_tooltip = oe_t2_crisis.1.a.tt
        add_gold = -150
        add_manpower = -1
        oe_t2_change_auth = { amount = -5 }
        hidden_effect = {
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_t2_crisis_theme ?= { has_variable = oe_tg_hereditary } }
                random_list = {
                    40 = { oe_t2_crisis_purge_win = yes }
                    60 = { oe_t2_crisis_purge_fail = yes }
                }
            }
            else = {
                random_list = {
                    70 = { oe_t2_crisis_purge_win = yes }
                    30 = { oe_t2_crisis_purge_fail = yes }
                }
            }
            oe_t2_crisis_clear_vars = yes
        }
        ai_chance = { factor = 35 }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_t2_crisis.1.b
        custom_tooltip = oe_t2_crisis.1.b.tt
        hidden_effect = {
            var:oe_t2_crisis_theme ?= {
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_t2_tax_concession_5y years = 5 mode = replace }
                oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = 20 }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
                international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_variable = oe_pillars_public_opinion }
                        change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_public_opinion add = -5 }
                        clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_public_opinion min = 0 max = 100 }
                    }
                }
            }
            oe_t2_crisis_clear_vars = yes
        }
        ai_chance = { factor = 45 }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_t2_crisis.1.c
        trigger = {
            has_variable = oe_t2_enforcer_theme
            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= { var:oe_pillars_authority >= 8 }
        }
        custom_tooltip = oe_t2_crisis.1.c.tt
        oe_t2_change_auth = { amount = -8 }
        hidden_effect = {
            oe_t2_crisis_neighbor_crackdown = yes
        }
        ai_chance = { factor = 60 }

}
